topic.title: Java Classes Generator Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Java Classes Generator add-on contributes a tool that generates Java classes from XML Schema files.

keywords.indexterm: Generate Java classes from XSD tool

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Developer
body.p: includes a tool for generating Java classes from an XML Schema (XSD) file. The Generate Java classes from XML Schema (XSD) action for invoking the tool can be found in the Tools menu. It requires an additional add-on to be installed, so the first time you invoke the action, will present a dialog box asking if you want to install it. Once installed, you need to restart and the action will invoke the Java class generator tool.
